newsitem.title: USA: Andrew adopts new rights plan.
newsitem.headline: Andrew adopts new rights plan.

text.p: Andrew Corp said its board has voted to adopt a new stockholder rights plan. The old plan will be terminated and rights under that plan will be redeemed.
"We simply needed a new plan since (over) the last four years consecutive stock splits had diluted the old plan's effectiveness," said chairman Floyd English in a statement.
Andrew's new rights will be distributed to stockholders of record at the close of business on December 16 as one common stock purchase right for each outstanding share of Andrew common stock.
The old rights will be redeemed for $0.0015 per old right at the close of business on the same date.
The new rights will be exercisable only if a person or group acquires 15 percent or more of the company's outstanding common or announces a tender offer for 15 percent or more of such shares.

In case of an unfriendly takeover attempt, stockholders will be entitled to buy more Andrew shares or, under certain circumstances, shares of either the acquiring or surviving company, at half the market price.
